mixed.qt: இந்தியாவின் முதல் செமிகண்டக்டர் உற்பத்தி தொழிற்சாலை அமைக்கப்படும் மாநிலம்?
mixed.exp: India's first semiconductor fab plant (Tata Electronics with PSMC) is being set up in Dholera, Gujarat under the 'India Semiconductor Mission'.

mixed.q: 'LVM3' (previously GSLV Mk III) is significant because:
opts: India's heaviest and most powerful launch vehicle, used for Chandrayaan-3 and Gaganyaan
mixed.exp: LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-3) is ISRO's heaviest and most powerful rocket — payload capacity 10 tonnes to LEO. Used for Chandrayaan-2, Chandrayaan-3, and planned for Gaganyaan.

mixed.q: 'Reusable Launch Vehicle' (RLV) technology is being developed by ISRO to:
opts: Significantly reduce cost of accessing space by reusing rocket stages
mixed.exp: ISRO's RLV-TD (Reusable Launch Vehicle - Technology Demonstrator) program aims to reduce launch costs by 10x through reusable rocket stages, like SpaceX Falcon 9.

opts: Nuclear fusion reactor that replicates the Sun's energy production
mixed.exp: 'Artificial Sun' refers to nuclear fusion reactors (like South Korea's KSTAR, or the international ITER project) that replicate the Sun's fusion process — potentially unlimited clean energy.

opts: Artificial induction of rainfall by dispersing silver iodide or dry ice into clouds
mixed.exp: Cloud Seeding is a weather modification technique — dispersing substances (silver iodide, dry ice) into clouds to encourage precipitation and induce rainfall.

opts: Number of transistors in an integrated circuit doubles approximately every 2 years
Computer processing speed halves every year
mixed.exp: Moore's Law (Gordon Moore, 1965) observed that the number of transistors in a microchip approximately doubles every 2 years, leading to exponential growth in computing power.

opts: Telecom services, internet services, and broadcasting
mixed.exp: TRAI regulates telecom services, internet services, and broadcasting in India — setting tariffs, ensuring quality of service, and protecting consumer interests.

mixed.q: 'Telemedicine' in India received a major boost through:
opts: Telemedicine Practice Guidelines (2020) and COVID-19 pandemic
mixed.exp: Telemedicine Practice Guidelines released by the Ministry of Health (March 2020) and the COVID-19 pandemic dramatically accelerated telemedicine adoption in India.

opts: Integrated approach recognising interconnection between human, animal, and ecosystem health
mixed.exp: 'One Health' is an integrated, collaborative approach recognising that human health, animal health, and ecosystem/environmental health are interconnected and interdependent.

opts: AI (deep learning) to create hyper-realistic fake videos/images of people
mixed.exp: Deep Fake uses deep learning AI (specifically Generative Adversarial Networks — GANs) to create hyper-realistic fake videos where a person appears to say or do things they never did.
PARAM Siddhi is a high-performance computing (HPC) AI supercomputer built under India's National Supercomputing Mission, ranked among top 100 globally in 2020.

mixed.q: 'Comet' differs from an 'Asteroid' mainly in that:
opts: Comets have a coma and tail (due to ices vaporizing); asteroids are rocky/metallic without coma
mixed.exp: Comets are composed of ice, dust, and rocky material — when near the Sun, their ices vaporize forming a bright coma and tail. Asteroids are mainly rocky/metallic without ices.

mixed.q: 'Dark Energy' constitutes approximately what percentage of the universe?
mixed.qt: 'இருண்ட ஆற்றல்' (Dark Energy) பிரபஞ்சத்தில் சுமார் எத்தனை சதவீதம்?
mixed.exp: Dark Energy constitutes ~68% of the universe (dark matter ~27%, ordinary matter ~5%). Dark Energy is hypothesised to be causing the universe's accelerating expansion.

opts: Accelerate development of affordable biopharmaceuticals and vaccines in India
mixed.exp: National Biopharma Mission (2017) aims to accelerate biopharmaceutical development — vaccines, biosimilars, diagnostics — building India's domestic biopharmaceutical ecosystem.

mixed.q: 'Chandrayaan-1' found water/hydroxyl on the Moon using which instrument?
opts: Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3 by NASA on Chandrayaan-1)
mixed.exp: The Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3), a NASA instrument on Chandrayaan-1, discovered water molecules and hydroxyl on the lunar surface in 2009.

mixed.q: 'Artificial Intelligence' in healthcare can help with:
opts: Disease diagnosis from images, drug discovery, personalised treatment, and predicting outbreaks
mixed.exp: AI in healthcare assists with: medical image analysis (radiology), drug discovery acceleration, personalized treatment plans, disease prediction, and administrative efficiency — supplementing, not replacing, doctors.
PARAM Ananta supercomputer (under National Supercomputing Mission) was installed at IIT Gandhinagar in 2022.

mixed.q:
Dark Matter — which are correct?
1. Interacts with electromagnetic force.
2. ~27% of universe's mass-energy.
3. Inferred from gravitational effects.
mixed.qt:
1. மின்காந்த விசையுடன் தொடர்பு.
2. ~27% திணிவு-ஆற்றல்.
3. ஈர்ப்பு விளைவால் அனுமானிக்கப்படுகிறது.
mixed.exp: Dark Matter does NOT interact with EM force — invisible (1 wrong). ~27% correct. Inferred from gravitational lensing/galaxy rotation (✓).

mixed.q:
India's nuclear doctrine — which are correct?
1. No-First-Use (NFU) policy.
2. India has nuclear triad.
3. India joined NPT as nuclear weapons state.
mixed.qt:
1. முதலில் பயன்படுத்தாது கொள்கை (NFU).
2. மூன்று வகை தாக்குதல் அமைப்பு.
3. NPT இல் அணுசக்தி நாடாக சேர்ந்தது.
mixed.exp: NFU (✓). Nuclear triad: Agni missiles + aircraft + Arihant submarines (✓). India has NOT signed NPT — outside the treaty (3 wrong).

opts: First human-made object in interstellar space
mixed.exp: Voyager 1 (1977) entered interstellar space in 2012 — most distant man-made object.

opts: Quantum superposition — system in multiple states until observed
mixed.exp: Illustrates quantum superposition applied to macroscopic objects — cat both alive and dead until observed.

opts: Gives mass to elementary particles via Higgs field
mixed.exp: Higgs Boson (discovered CERN 2012) confirms the Higgs field which gives mass to elementary particles. Nobel 2013.

opts: Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats
Circular Replication in Specific Protein Regions
Controlled RNA Interference for Specific Protein Regulation
mixed.exp: CRISPR = Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats — naturally occurring sequences in bacteria.

opts: Contradiction between high probability of alien life and lack of evidence
mixed.exp: Fermi Paradox: given vast universe and probability of alien life, why haven't we detected any signs of extraterrestrial intelligence?

opts: Crop monitoring, disaster management, urban planning, mineral exploration
mixed.exp: Remote sensing: crop health, flood/disaster management, urban sprawl, deforestation, mineral exploration.
Originated in Tamil Nadu from devadasi temple tradition. Revived by Rukmini Devi Arundale.
Ajanta (2nd BCE–6th CE) mainly depicts Buddhist Jataka tales.
Mohiniyattam = classical dance of Kerala, graceful swaying movements.
Bharata Muni (200 BCE–200 CE) — foundational treatise on Indian performing arts.
Konark Sun Temple in Odisha — UNESCO WHS, built by Narasimhadeva I (13th century).

mixed.q: Dravidian temple architecture is characterized by:
mixed.exp: Dravidian style = tall ornate Gopuram (gateway towers). Nagara style = Shikhara.

mixed.q: Carnatic music is practiced primarily in:
mixed.exp: Carnatic classical music = TN, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Kerala.
Kuchipudi from Kuchipudi village, AP — fast rhythmic footwork.
Trinity: Thyagaraja (1767–1847), Syama Sastri (1762–1827), Muthuswami Dikshitar (1775–1835).
Odissi = classical dance of Odisha, from temple Mahari and Gotipua dancer traditions.
Rath Yatra = annual chariot festival of Lord Jagannath at Puri, Odisha.

mixed.q: Kathak is associated with which region?
mixed.exp: Kathak = classical dance of North India (UP), originating from storytelling Kathakas.

mixed.q: National anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' was composed by:
mixed.exp: Jana Gana Mana composed by Rabindranath Tagore. Adopted 24 January 1950.
Lotus (Nelumbo nucifera) is India's national flower.
Manipuri dance — gentle, lyrical, based on Vaishnavite themes.
Kangra Painting (Pahari School) from Himachal Pradesh — delicate brushwork, Krishna's life scenes.
Madhubani (Mithila) painting from Bihar — geometric patterns, Hindu deities.

mixed.q: Hampi ruins are remains of the:
mixed.exp: Hampi (UNESCO) was capital of the Vijayanagara Empire (14th–17th century) in Karnataka.
Tansen = Akbar's greatest court musician, one of the Nine Gems (Navaratnas).
Sangam literature: ancient Tamil corpus compiled in three Sangam periods, ~300 BCE–300 CE.

mixed.q: Ajanta and Ellora Caves are in:
mixed.exp: Both in Aurangabad, Maharashtra — both UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Khajuraho (UNESCO, Madhya Pradesh) — intricate sculptural work and excellent Nagara architecture.
Tamil is one of the world's oldest living classical languages with 2,000+ years of literature.
Pongal is Tamil Nadu's harvest festival, celebrated in mid-January.
Warli tribal art from Maharashtra — geometric shapes depicting daily life.
Qutb ud-Din Aibak started (1193) and Iltutmish completed (1220) the Qutub Minar.

mixed.q: Bihu is a folk dance/festival from:
mixed.exp: Bihu = national folk dance and harvest festival of Assam (three types: Bohag, Kati, Magh).
Bhangra = energetic folk dance of Punjab, associated with Baisakhi harvest festival.
Diwali celebrates Lord Ram's return to Ayodhya after 14 years of exile and victory over Ravana.

opts: Melodic frameworks with ascending/descending note patterns
mixed.exp: A Raga = melodic framework (notes, rules for ascent/descent, characteristic phrases) conveying a specific mood.
Ellora: 17 Hindu + 12 Buddhist + 5 Jain caves — unique religious harmony.
4 Vedas: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda.
Thiruvalluvar wrote Thirukkural — 1330 couplets on Aram, Porul, Inbam.
Pattachitra (scroll painting) practiced in Odisha and West Bengal — Jagannath mythology.

mixed.q: Ganesh Chaturthi most prominently celebrated in:
mixed.exp: Maharashtra (especially Mumbai and Pune). Popularised by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
Lohri celebrated in Punjab/Haryana on 13 January — end of winter, harvest.
Sattriya = classical dance from Assam, founded by 15th-century saint Srimanta Sankardev.

mixed.q: City of Temples in Tamil Nadu:
mixed.exp: Madurai = Temple City, famous for the Meenakshi Amman Temple.
Garba = circular folk dance from Gujarat, performed during Navratri in honour of Goddess Durga.
Shore Temples and rock-cut monuments built by Pallava kings (7th–8th century CE), especially Narasimhavarman I.

mixed.q: Guru Granth Sahib is the scripture of:
mixed.qt: 'குரு கிரந்த சாஹிப்' எந்த மதத்தின் புனித நூல்?
mixed.exp: Guru Granth Sahib is the eternal living Guru and scripture of Sikhism.
Andal (Kodhai) — only female Alvar — composed Thirupaavai (30 verses), sung during Margazhi.
Pashmina comes from the Changthangi goat of Ladakh/Kashmir Changthang plateau — one of the finest fibres.
Pushkar Camel Fair held annually in Pushkar, Rajasthan — one of the world's largest camel fairs.

mixed.q: Sitar is which type of instrument?
mixed.exp: Sitar = plucked string instrument. Ravi Shankar brought it to global recognition.
Original Ramayana composed in Sanskrit by Valmiki (24,000 slokas). Tamil version by Kambar (12th century).

mixed.q: UNESCO Intangible Heritage from India includes:
mixed.qt: இந்தியாவிலிருந்து UNESCO அருமதியான கலாச்சார பாரம்பரியப் பட்டியல்?
opts: Vedic chanting, Ramlila, Chhau dance, Kumbh Mela, Durga Puja, Garba and others
mixed.exp: UNESCO ICH from India includes: Vedic chanting, Ramlila, Chhau, Kalbelia, Mudiyettu, Thatheras, Yoga, Kumbh Mela, Kolkata Durga Puja, Garba.
Gita Govinda by Jayadeva (12th century) — lyrical Sanskrit poem about Radha-Krishna.
4 Vedas: Rigveda (oldest), Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda.

mixed.q: Mahabharata is called the '5th Veda' because:
opts: It made spiritual knowledge accessible to those who couldn't study the four Vedas
It is the largest Sanskrit text
It was composed 5 centuries after the Vedas
mixed.exp: Mahabharata (attributed to Vyasa) = 'Fifth Veda' as it brought Vedic wisdom to common people who couldn't study the original four Vedas.

opts: Buddhist themes in natural mineral colours, intricate narrative art
mixed.exp: Ajanta (2nd BCE–6th CE) — Buddhist themes painted in natural mineral colours, showing sophisticated artistic techniques.

opts: Elaborate costumes with large headgear, and stylized face paint depicting character types
mixed.exp: Kathakali (Kerala) is known for elaborate costumes, large headgear (Kireedam), and detailed face paint that identifies character types (Pacha, Kathi, Minukku etc.).

mixed.q: Nayanmars are associated with which religion?
mixed.exp: The 63 Nayanmars are Tamil Shaivite saints (devotees of Lord Shiva), part of the Tamil Bhakti movement.

mixed.q: The 'Deccan Sultanates' emerged from the break-up of:
mixed.exp: Five Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Berar, Bidar) emerged from break-up of the Bahmani Sultanate in 1518.
Sangeet Natak Akademi — national academy for music, dance, and drama — established 31 May 1952.
Dilwara Temples near Mount Abu, Rajasthan are exquisite Jain marble temples (11th-13th century CE), famous for intricate white marble carvings.

mixed.q: 'Chaturanga' is the ancient Indian game that evolved into:
mixed.qt: 'சதுரங்க' என்ற பண்டைய இந்திய விளையாட்டு எதாக வளர்ந்தது?
mixed.exp: Chaturanga (Sanskrit: 'four divisions of the military') is the ancient Indian game from which modern Chess evolved, via Persian Shatranj.

mixed.q: 'ICCR' (Indian Council for Cultural Relations) was founded by:
mixed.exp: ICCR established in 1950 by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (India's first Education Minister) to promote India's culture internationally.

mixed.q: Tansen Music Festival is held at:
mixed.exp: Tansen Music Festival held annually at Gwalior, MP, near Tansen's tomb.
Chhau practiced in three states: Seraikella (Jharkhand), Mayurbhanj (Odisha), Purulia (West Bengal). UNESCO 2010.

mixed.q: Sangam age literature is classified into Akam and Puram representing:
mixed.qt: சங்க கால இலக்கியம் அகம் மற்றும் புறம் என பிரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது — அவை குறிக்கும் கருத்து?
mixed.exp: Akam = subjective love poetry; Puram = objective heroic/public poetry about war, valor, kings' generosity.
Kathakali = classical dance-drama of Kerala — elaborate costumes, makeup, expressing Hindu epics.
Kolam (called Rangoli in North, Muggu in Andhra) predominantly practiced in Tamil Nadu — geometric rice-flour patterns.

mixed.q: Brihadeeshwarar temple at Thanjavur was built by:
mixed.exp: Rajaraja Chola I (985–1014 CE) built the Brihadeeshwarar Temple — UNESCO WHS, largest Dravidian temple.

mixed.q: Hinayana and Mahayana are schools of:
mixed.exp: Hinayana (Theravada) and Mahayana are two main schools of Buddhism.

mixed.q: Bodhisattva concept in Buddhism refers to:
opts: Being who delays nirvana to help all sentient beings
mixed.exp: Bodhisattva = enlightened being who delays own Nirvana to help all beings achieve liberation. Central to Mahayana.

mixed.q: Upanishads are part of which literature?
mixed.exp: Upanishads (108 in number) are the philosophical concluding portion of the Vedas (Vedanta). 800-500 BCE.

opts: Distinguished service of high order in any field
mixed.exp: Padma Awards (Vibhushan, Bhushan, Shri) for distinguished service in any field — art, science, public affairs, etc.
Ancient Silk Road connected India with Central Asia, Persia (Iran), and China, facilitating trade and cultural exchange.

mixed.q: The 'Kolkata Durga Puja' was inscribed by UNESCO on ICH list in:
mixed.qt: கொல்கத்தா துர்கா பூஜை யுனெஸ்கோ பட்டியலில் சேர்க்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டு?
mixed.exp: Durga Puja of Kolkata was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity list in December 2021.

mixed.q: Garba dance was inscribed on UNESCO ICH list in:
mixed.qt: கர்பா நடனம் யுனெஸ்கோ பட்டியலில் சேர்க்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டு?
mixed.exp: Garba of Gujarat was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in December 2023.

mixed.q: Meenakshi Amman Temple is famous for:
mixed.exp: Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple — 12 towering gopurams, thousands of intricate sculptures.
Brihadaranyaka Upanishad is associated with the Shukla Yajurveda — one of the oldest, most important Upanishads.
Nagarjunasagar Dam across Krishna River in Telangana/AP — one of world's largest masonry dams.

mixed.q: 'Chaturanga' → Chess — the ancient game originated in:
mixed.exp: Chess originated in India as Chaturanga (~6th century CE), spread to Persia as Shatranj, then to the West as Chess.

mixed.q: 'Yakshagana' is a traditional theatre form from:
mixed.exp: Yakshagana is a traditional theatre form from Karnataka combining dance, music, dialogue, and costume based on mythological themes.
Hornbill Festival is celebrated in Nagaland every December — a cultural extravaganza showcasing the traditions of all Naga tribes.

mixed.q: 'Theyyam' is a ritual dance form from:
mixed.exp: Theyyam is a ritual dance form from the Malabar region of northern Kerala — a form of worship where the performer becomes the deity.
Chikankari is a traditional embroidery style from Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh) — delicate hand embroidery with floral motifs on fine fabric.

mixed.q: The 'Dashavatar' cycle in Indian art represents:
mixed.exp: Dashavatar refers to the 10 principal avatars (incarnations) of Lord Vishnu — Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Parashurama, Rama, Krishna (or Balarama), Buddha, and Kalki.

opts: An ancient Indian martial art from Kerala
mixed.exp: Kalaripayattu is an ancient Indian martial art originating from Kerala, considered one of the oldest fighting systems in the world — includes strikes, kicks, grappling, and weapons.

mixed.q: The 'Vedanta' school of philosophy is associated with:
opts: Study of the Vedas' concluding portions (Upanishads) and metaphysical concepts
mixed.exp: Vedanta ('end of the Vedas') is based on the Upanishads, Brahma Sutras, and Bhagavad Gita. Major sub-schools: Advaita (Shankaracharya), Vishishtadvaita (Ramanuja), Dvaita (Madhvacharya).
Lavani is a traditional folk dance of Maharashtra performed to dhol beats.
Kambala is a traditional buffalo race held in the Tulu Nadu region of coastal Karnataka, especially in Dakshina Kannada and Udupi districts.
Ghumar is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan performed by Bhil tribe women, characterized by graceful swirling movements. Now considered the 'folk dance of Rajasthan'.

opts: A battle formation shaped like a lotus
mixed.exp: Padmavyuha (Chakravyuha) in the Mahabharata was a military formation shaped like a lotus/spiral — Abhimanyu (Arjuna's son) entered it but couldn't exit, leading to his death.

opts: Nayanmars' (Shaivite saints') Tamil hymns compiled in 12 volumes
mixed.exp: Thirumurai is a 12-volume collection of Tamil hymns by the 63 Nayanmars (Shaivite saints). The first 11 volumes include works by saints like Appar, Sundarar, Thirugnanasambandar. The 12th (Periya Puranam) is by Sekkizhar.
